02 / A LITTLE CONTEXT

A designer.
An engineer.
Always curious.

TRVYYZ8.5° N, 76.9° E     43.7° N, 79.4° W

From Trivandrum to Toronto, with a few interesting turns along the way.

I started in software engineering, then moved closer to the people using the things we build. I bring 15+ years of design experience to questions of flow, structure, usability, and interaction.

Today, I work in Product Design at BeyondTrust, helping make complex enterprise cybersecurity tools easier to understand and use. My focus spans user flows, interaction design, and design systems, with prototyping as a way to explore ideas and work through the details.

Earlier, I established a UX practice at Attinad and led designers and front-end engineers. That experience, together with my engineering background, keeps me close to both the big picture and the details of making it work.

Beyond the screen: photography, music, and a lasting connection to Kerala. The interests change the pace; the curiosity stays.
